title: Verb Room WebView contract v1: commands (payload of kind=command)

SurfaceTranslate.description: Delta is relative to the transaction start snapshot, never accumulated. With autoLink, eligible adjacent wall endpoints within 0.0001 m in that snapshot follow the XY delta.

SurfaceMoveVertex.description: wall: vertex 0=a,1=b. autoLink (default true) moves coincident corners of pickable walls together.

groupName.description: Assign the new surface to this construction, extending an existing unlocked group. Optional; omitted leaves it ungrouped.

SurfaceSetAbsorption.description: Only listed bands change; others untouched (differs from mockup shareMaterial).

SurfaceSetTransmission.description: Wire value is tau; TL = -10log10(tau); opaque = tau 0. No 60/99 dB sentinel.

SurfaceSetHeights.description: zTopM null = full height; heightM null = patch (zones).

HistoryRedo.description: Unavailable in v1 (capability history.redo=false) -> error unsupported.

PresetLoad.description: builtin: id = decimal index; user: opaque id from preset.list; file: native FileChooser (no id).

PresetSave.description: C++ shows overwrite confirmation; replies ioError on write failure.

IrExport.description: C++ opens the folder chooser; JS never sends a filesystem path.

AnalysisStart.description: source -1 = all audible; components bitmask direct=1 early=2 tail=4. Engine accepts wider ranges (energy.cpp:51-54); these are the native UI values.

SessionSetViewState.description: Opaque, versioned, <= limits.maxViewStateBytes; survives editor close, NOT saved in the project.

FollowOffsetInput.description: V04d: offset in the path frame [forward, left, up] in metres (forward = horizontal tangent of the target's drawn path, left = horizontal perpendicular, up = world Z).

PathLink.description: V04d: link one or several sources to another source's path (rig). One undo step.

PathSetFollow.description: V04d: edit a follower's link (offset gesture = one undo step inside a transaction; target change; Follow wander).

PathUnlink.description: V04d: convert a follower into an own path (the current offset curve sampled into 64 points).

zoneId.description: V04c: zone id for the inZone / distanceToZone drivers (required, >= 1); ignored (0) for other drivers.

midi.description: V04e: optional MIDI out; mode 'off' (or omitting the key) removes it. Missing fields take the defaults channel 1, number 60, velocity 100, threshold 0.5, hysteresis 0.05, lengthMs 100, ccLo 0, ccHi 127.

ZoneCreate.description: V04c: add a trigger zone (max 16). One undo step 'Add zone'.

points.description: box: two opposite plan corners; polygon: 3..32 vertices of a simple outline (metres, clamped to the room).

ZoneSet.description: V04c: change fields of a zone (partial). Coalesces per zone; wrap drags in a transaction.

points.description: box: two opposite plan corners; polygon: 3..32 vertices of a simple outline (metres, clamped to the room).

ZoneMove.description: V04c: reorder (list order = Zone index priority).
